correctness.rationale: Writing q_ij(s)=beta_ij(s)/s gives convex stochastic update with self-weight ≥1-theta>0. Old extrema remain bounds. Let b(r)=max_edge,max_|s|≤r |beta(s)|≤theta*r; then D_(t+1)≥D_t-2b(D_t)≥(1-2theta)D_t>0. Strong connectivity propagates strict drop from an old max (and rise from old min) in at most n-1 steps; compactness and continuity force limiting diameter 0. Flatness b(D_t)/D_t→0 proves adjacent diameter ratio→1 and Cesaro logarithmic mean gives subgeometric convergence. For d_(t+1)=d_t-2exp(-d_t^-alpha), letting y=d^-alpha gives Delta y=2alpha y^(1+1/alpha)exp(-y)(1+o(1)); H(y)=exp(y)/y^(1+1/alpha) has Delta H→2alpha, so H(y_t)~2alpha t, yielding three-term expansion and overshoot-controlled accuracy time. For analytic beta(s)=a s^m+O(s^(m+2)), reciprocal-power increments give m=1 geometric, m odd>=3 t^-1/(m-1).
